measures.what: outer diameter of the board, and its thickness
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two small mounting holes near the centre: hole diameter, distance between the hole centres, and whether the line between them passes through the board's centre (and its angle relative to where the input wires leave)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: on the back (non-LED side): the 4-pin connector's footprint (length x width), its height off the back face, and the distance from the board centre to the connector's centre; plus the height of any other parts on the back
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: length, width and thickness of the board; corner hole diameter and the centre-to-centre spacing of the holes along the long side and the short side
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: height of the tallest thing above the top face (ESP32 on its headers, capacitor, terminals), and how far solder joints/leads stick out below the bottom face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: which perfboard edge the port faces, how far the port mouth is from that edge (in or overhanging), its sideways offset from the board's centre line, and the height of the port's centre above the perfboard top face
measures.reply: esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: wall screws and USB-C charger cable
measures.what: wall screw head diameter and shank diameter; and the USB-C plug's plastic overmould width x thickness
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most

measures.item: ESP32 on perfboard (USB-C port you'll plug into)
measures.what: Lay a ruler/calipers on the perfboard: (a) distance from the perfboard's nearest short (50 mm) edge to the port's mouth — say if the mouth is inside or beyond that edge; (b) distance from one long (70 mm) edge of the perfboard to the centre of that port, and which long edge (left/right looking at the port with ESP32 on top). If the port faces a long edge instead, say so.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: Is the back flat apart from the 4-pin connector? Roughly how tall does the connector (with its plug/wires) stand off the back, and about how far is it from the board's centre, in which direction (12 o'clock = where the wires leave)? A ruler held across the board for the diameter would also help, even roughly.
measures.reply: led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the plastic overmould around the plug: width x thickness, and the length of the metal part that goes into the port
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: Hold it with the USB-C port you'll use facing you, ESP32 on top. Please measure: (1) from the perfboard's LEFT long edge to the centre of that USB-C port; (2) from the perfboard's short edge nearest you to the port's mouth (+ if the port sticks out past the perfboard edge, − if it's set back inside it). (3) Are the other things (screw terminals, capacitor, wires to the disc) closer to you or the far end?
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge
